description: This file defines the interface CalendarDropdownReadPlatformService, which provides methods to retrieve various calendar-related options as lists of EnumOptionData objects, serving as a service layer for calendar dropdown options within the system.

classes.name: CalendarDropdownReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to retrieve calendar-related dropdown options, such as entity types, calendar types, reminder options, frequency types, weekdays, and nth-day frequency types.

methods.name: retrieveCalendarEntityTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData representing available calendar entity types.

methods.name: retrieveCalendarTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData representing available calendar types.

methods.name: retrieveCalendarRemindByOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData representing how reminders are set for calendar events.

methods.name: retrieveCalendarFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData representing available frequency types for calendars.

methods.name: retrieveCalendarWeekDaysTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData representing days of the week options.

methods.name: retrieveCalendarFrequencyNthDayTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData representing options for nth-day frequency types.
